caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a rectangular mirror with a decorative top edge. The mirror is oriented vertically and has a wooden frame that is brown in color. The top of the frame features a wavy, scalloped design, while the sides and bottom are straight. The mirror itself displays a slightly cloudy or mottled surface in shades of light blue-green and pale gray, suggesting reflections or aging. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing is signed "Rex Dolomith" in the bottom right corner using small, black text. There are no other objects or details present in the drawing.
title: Pier-glass
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
